# inngest_environments (Data Source)

Lists the account's Inngest environments, optionally only one type. Use `type = "BRANCH"` to list branch environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every active branch environment, for example to find stale previews.
data "inngest_environments" "branches" {
  type = "BRANCH"
}

output "branch_environments" {
  value = [for e in data.inngest_environments.branches.environments : e.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Also list archived environments. Defaults to `false`.
- `type` (String) Only list environments explicitly reporting this type: `PRODUCTION`, `TEST` or `BRANCH`. Environments whose type is omitted are excluded.

### Read-Only

- `environments` (Attributes List) The environments, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the environment is archived.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Environment ID.
- `name` (String) Environment name.
- `type` (String) Environment type, or null when omitted by the API.
